environment.description: Lambda@Edge function deployed as origin-request trigger on CloudFront distribution d1234abcdef.cloudfront.net. Distribution configured with custom origin pointing to internal ALB (internal-proxy-alb-123456.us-east-1.elb.amazonaws.com). Origin protocol policy: HTTP only. No origin custom headers configured for validation. CloudFront behavior configured with 'All HTTP methods' allowed, viewer protocol policy HTTPS-only, no signed URL/cookie requirement (public distribution). Cache policy: CachingDisabled. Origin request policy: AllViewerAndCloudFrontHeaders-2022-06. The backend ALB forwards to nginx reverse proxy fleet that uses HTTP/1.1 keep-alive connections to upstream services.
